observations: Photo 0 shows a top-loading washing machine with a front control panel area not clearly visible.
A label on the lid/front reads “NEXUS”.
No visible brand/model plate, capacity (kg), or power/rating information is readable.
No photo shows the drum condition, lid seal, drain hose, or control buttons in use.

claims.evidence: No photo or text evidence confirms location (Abulegba).
Photo 0 shows a “NEXUS” label on the machine, not Midea.

risks.risk: Brand mismatch: the photo shows “NEXUS” while the seller claims “Midea”, which affects value and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the machine’s rating/brand plate (usually on the back or side) showing brand and model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unknown-condition washing machine (worst case vs the comparables).

risks.risk: Unknown capacity (kg) and type (fully automatic vs semi-automatic) because it’s not readable in the photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the rating plate showing capacity (kg) and model, plus a photo of the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest comparable level.

risks.risk: Working condition not proven (no test run, no sound/operation shown).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of a full wash cycle starting (water filling → agitation → draining) or at least a power-on + spin test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/assume worst case (treat like faulty/needs checking).

risks.risk: Possible missing parts/accessories (drain hose, inlet hose, knobs) not visible.
risks.proof: Ask for photos showing included hoses and all knobs/buttons, and the back connections.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest comparable level until accessories are confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating/brand/model plate (back/side) showing brand, model number, and capacity (kg).
Photo of the control panel with all buttons/knobs visible.
Short video of a wash cycle (or at minimum: power on, water fill, agitation, and draining).
Photos of the back connections and included inlet/drain hoses.
response.reason: The photo contradicts the seller’s claimed brand (shows “NEXUS” not Midea) and key pricing factors (capacity, exact model, and working condition) are not verifiable from the single image.
